The reference may be to the sinful type of conversation, as mentioned in the previous verses, or to the practice of two persons speaking in confidence in the presence of a third, which might lead him to assume that he is the subject of their conversation.  Such behavior was prohibited by the Prophet (ﷺ) in narrations of al-Bukhārī and Muslim.
